adjudication.rationale: The diff adds nontrivial controller behavior in `Admin::EmbeddableHostsController` (`create/update/destroy` + `save_host` params handling and `category_id` blank defaulting to `SiteSetting.uncategorized_category_id`, plus the error branch `render_json_error`), and `Admin::EmbeddingController` (`show/update` rendering an OpenStruct-backed serializer). The only added specs for these controllers merely assert they subclass `Admin::AdminController` (`spec/controllers/admin/embeddable_hosts_controller_spec.rb`, `spec/controllers/admin/embedding_controller_spec.rb`) and do not exercise any of that behavior, so regressions in the host CRUD contract or embedding endpoints would not be caught. (Additionally, the new `update/destroy` paths can 500 on a missing id because `where(...).first` may return nil and the code calls methods on it, but the finding’s core point—missing behavioral coverage for newly introduced logic—is directly supported by the diff.)
